## Description and Rationale

I’m Abd Elilah Tauil, a 29-year-old teacher from Morocco participating independently. I joined the PRC Data Challenge to tackle a real aviation data problem and develop an original, accurate, and reproducible solution for predicting taxi-out times. My goal is to achieve a top ranking and compete for a prize.
